readmeMarkdown: # Antigravity Token Tracker Plugin Production-grade Hybrid Token Tracker plugin for Antigravity providing real-time context window usage, prompt cache hit ratios, context compaction countdown, and Language Server quota telemetry via synchronized in-app UI and native Sidecar Aux Pane dashboard. --- ## Key Features 1. **Context Window Tracking**: - Real-time active tokens, maximum context window tokens, and percentage utilization. - Comprehensive model catalog covering Gemini 4, Gemini 3.x, and Gemini 2.5 (1M/2M context), Claude 5.5 and 4.x (200k/1M context), OpenAI GPT-5, GPT-4.1, o3/o4, and GPT-OSS, DeepSeek, and Grok. 2. **Prompt Cache Efficiency**: - Accurate tracking of cached prompt tokens vs. newly computed tokens. - Cache hit ratio percentage reflecting prefix caching gains. 3. **Context Compaction Headroom**: - Tracks active prompt context size relative to each model's context window capacity. - Calculates remaining tokens and KB headroom until Antigravity's per-model automatic compaction trigger is reached (such as 512k for Gemini 4, 256k for Gemini 3.x Flash, and 160k for 200k Claude models). - Generates proactive compaction advisory warnings as active context approaches the compaction trigger. 4. **Language Server Connect-RPC Quota Telemetry**: - Direct integration with local Language Server `RetrieveUserQuotaSummary` RPC over HTTP. - Auto-discovers active port and `x-codeium-csrf-token` from environment, daemon manifests (`~/.gemini/antigravity/daemon/hub_*.json`), and server logs. - Live 5-Hour and Weekly limits with human-readable reset countdowns (e.g. `1h 25m`, `5d 14h`) for both Gemini Models and Claude/GPT 3P models. 5. **Synchronized Dual Interface**: - **In-Input-Box Status Pill**: Injected directly into `#antigravity.agentSidePanelInputBox` to the left of the `Turbo ∨` Local Permissions selector. Displays live pill summary with color-coded status dot and interactive hover/click telemetry popover card. - **Native Aux Pane Sidecar Web UI**: Official `SIDECAR_UI_ENTRYPOINT_AUX_PANE` dashboard in `sidecars/dashboard/` displaying a compact 4-across health color-coded quota strip (`Gemini 5-Hour`, `Gemini Weekly`, `Claude/GPT 5-Hour`, `Claude/GPT Weekly`), a live Active Agents tree with mirrored conversation status icons (processing, waiting for response, error, and idle duration), clickable conversation and subagent titles for instant navigation, health color-coded circular progress rings (default view) and compact metrics, dark/light Antigravity theme synchronization, and a header toggle between ring and text views for active subagents. --- ## Quick Install (npx) Install the plugin directly into Google Antigravity using `npx`: > **Note:** Antigravity requires a standard copied plugin directory rather than a symlink or Windows junction. Run the `npx` install command below to deploy a clean copy into your plugins folder. ```bash # Install plugin into Antigravity plugins directory (~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker/) npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install # Inject real-time status-bar pill into Antigravity input box npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install-injector # Uninstall plugin when no longer needed npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker uninstall ``` ### CLI Commands & Options | Command | Description | | :--- | :--- | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install` | Installs plugin into global Antigravity config directory (`~/.gemini/config/plugins/token-tracker/`) | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install --workspace` | Installs plugin into current workspace (`.gemini/plugins/token-tracker/`) | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker uninstall` | Removes plugin from global Antigravity config directory | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker uninstall --workspace` | Removes plugin from current workspace directory | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install-injector` | Patches Electron `app.asar` to enable the status-bar pill | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker install-injector --dry-run` | Validates ASAR patching integrity without mutating files | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker uninstall-injector` | Restores pristine `app.asar` from backup and unlinks script | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker --version` | Displays current version (`v1.1.2`) | | `npx antigravity-plugin-token-tracker --help` | Displays CLI usage instructions and options | --- ### On-Demand Agent Status & Subagent Monitoring Antigravity Token Tracker includes a built-in status tool (`token_tracker_status`) registered automatically through `mcp_config.json`, allowing agents to check live telemetry whenever needed without extra prompt overhead: - **Live Context & Cache Snapshot**: Inspect active model capacity, context usage, prompt cache hit efficiency, and compaction headroom on demand. - **Subagent Visibility**: Monitor token usage, cache efficiency, and active status across child subagents spawned during a session. - **Optional Quota Check**: Retrieve current 5-hour and weekly quota levels alongside conversation telemetry in either concise Markdown or structured JSON. --- ## Architecture Overview ``` antigravity-plugin-token-tracker/ ├── assets/ │ └── icon.svg # Plugin vector icon badge ├── bin/ │ └── cli.js # Unified NPX CLI entry point (install/injector) ├── package.json # Manifest & npm lifecycle scripts ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin descriptor ├── CHANGELOG.md # Release history and version notes ├── hooks.json # SessionStart & PreInvocation hook declarations ├── mcp_config.json # On-demand Token Tracker status tool registration ├── hooks/ │ ├── session-start.js # SessionStart hook reporting live context, cache & quota status │ └── pre-invocation.js # PreInvocation hook injecting live context & compaction advisories ├── lib/ │ ├── model-catalog.js # Immutable model context window catalog │ ├── model-detector.js # Binary & text model identifier extraction │ ├── models.js # Model normalization & context window sizing │ ├── compaction.js # Active-context compaction threshold & headroom calculations │ ├── ls-rpc.js # Loopback Connect-RPC HTTP transport helper │ ├── quota-service.js # Connect-RPC client for RetrieveUserQuotaSummary │ ├── conversation-tracker.js # Read-only SQLite parser for conversation telemetry │ ├── subagent-tracker.js # Child subagent discovery & context telemetry reader │ ├── active-status.js # Live active vs. idle session & path confinement helpers │ ├── agent-tree.js # Active main & subagent tree discovery │ └── telemetry-server.js # Loopback HTTP server (127.0.0.1:8976) ├── mcp/ │ ├── server.js # On-demand status tool server for Antigravity agents │ ├── status-tool.js # Status tool schema, validation, and handler │ └── format.js # Markdown & JSON status output formatters ├── injector/ │ ├── status-bar.js # Vanilla JS widget mounting to #antigravity.agentSidePanelInputBox │ ├── install.js # Safe, non-destructive installer with backup & rollback │ └── uninstall.js # Pristine rollback uninstaller restoring app.asar ├── sidecars/ │ └── dashboard/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Native Aux Pane sidecar descriptor │ ├── server.mjs # sidecar_sdk server with standalone fallback │ ├── index.html # Dense compact tree dashboard structure │ ├── styles.css # Theme-aware compact tree & quota strip styles │ └── app.js # Live telemetry polling & DOM tree renderer ├── scripts/ │ └── audit-gate.js # Deterministic P0 static audit gate └── tests/ └── run-all.js # Comprehensive unit & integration test runner ``` --- ## Verification & Testing Run unit and integration test suite: ```bash npm test ``` Execute the deterministic static audit gate: ```bash npm run audit-gate ```
